title: Multi-series line with end labels
intent: Compare three chronological series and label the final observation of each series directly, following Observable Plot's selectLast example without requiring a separate legend.

source.title: Observable Plot select transform — multi-series end labels

ai.create: Create a responsive three-series UTC line chart from tidy {id, date, value, series} rows. Give each series a stable color and directly label its final observation; do not introduce a proprietary series data model, casts, or a hand-maintained endpoint array.
ai.maintain: Move the direct labels from the last observation to the first observation of each series while retaining series colors, stable line keys, inferred callback data, and readable label space.
